replies.text:
Hi Sanjog,

Please find below:

Q1. Face Wash on Flipkart - The gap is driven by lower traffic. Our clicks
in the prev. month were 9.8L which dropped to 6.7L in the current month.
This is primarily attributed to reduced influencer marketing spend during
this period. Conversion on the traffic we did get stayed strong. Gross CVR
was 5.8% MTD, up from 5.5% last month and 5.3% over the last three months

Q2. Soap on Flipkart - The gap is driven by lower traffic. Our clicks in
the prev. month were 4.37L which dropped to 1.52L in the current month.
This is primarily attributed to reduced influencer marketing spend during
this period. Conversion on the traffic we did get stayed strong. Gross CVR
was 6.4% MTD, up from 4.3% last month and 4.3% over the last three months

Q3. Face Wash on Meesho - The gap is also traffic-led. Reduced influencer
spend lowered impressions and clicks on Meesho

Q4. Henna on Meesho (137.4% of target, Rs. 47,445 ad spend) - ROI for Henna
operated at 26 for pack of 1, and 7.6 for pack of 2 during the period of
October. Towards the end of October, we did reduce spends on Henna for pack
of 1 and stopped for pack of 2 because we wanted to be-line with our
allocated budget, and demand for henna is seasonal and tapers off in
winter, so continuing at this level would have given diminishing returns.
We are currently operating at a Rs. 500 budget for pack of 1 on Meesho
while the pack of 2 campaign is paused. We will continue this till Diwali
and then experiment by stopping spends altogether for Henna.

Q5. Soap on Meesho (37.6% actual vs 31.2% planned) - We had shared the
event pricing with Meesho back in September, it was in-line with Flipkart
and Amazon’s event pricing for the month of October. NLTB and variants were
our biggest selling SKUs which operated at a higher than planned discount
which caused the discounting to be up against planned. This has been
corrected for the month of November (after their Maha Diwali Sale), wherein
we have taken our SPs back to September levels

Q6. Shampoo on Meesho (28.7% actual vs 32.0% planned) - Shampoo’s actual
discount came in 3.3 pp below plan, so we spent less on discounting than
budgeted
